from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EPSRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single EPS data point extracted from one financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock code of the company")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2025 Q1')")
    basic_eps: float | None = Field(description="Basic Earnings Per Share value")
    is_valid: bool = Field(default=True, description="Whether the EPS value is valid and usable for averaging")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated records from all provided documents."""
    eps_records: list[EPSRecord]
